# ModGuard AI

> Enterprise AI content moderation and deepfake detection. ScamCheck is the free AI scam checker.

ModGuard AI (https://modguardai.org) publishes the product site for an enterprise content moderation and deepfake detection suite. ScamCheck (https://scamcheck.modguardai.org) is the free AI scam checker.

## Products

- [ScamCheck](https://scamcheck.modguardai.org): Free AI scam checker
- [Home](https://modguardai.org/): Defend, detect, and verify synthetic media
- [Live demo](https://modguardai.org/demo): Upload image, video, or audio for a detection demo
- [API](https://modguardai.org/api): API documentation and sandbox
- [Pricing](https://modguardai.org/pricing): Starter $49/month, Professional $199/month, Enterprise custom

## Claims published on the site

- Homepage: deepfake detection powered by Reality Defender's API, 99.7% detection accuracy, response under 2 seconds, 24/7 live protection
- Homepage technology cards also describe real-time processing under 100ms
- Feature pages publish separate accuracy and speed figures per capability (deepfake detection is listed at 99.2%)
- Early access copy refers to 12,000+ professionals waiting
- Professional plan includes cultural context filtering
- Founder: Samuel Fagbamigbe, CEO and co-founder (samuel@modguardai.com)
